title: StockSmart Inventory Finance Questions — Release from a Recent Consignment Withdrawal on a Credit Hold Fill
content:
**Rule.** For the first customer-owned fill of a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin converted from consignment, booked while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold, consigned stock of the converted item withdrawn the same day adds a release of half (0.5 times) its withdrawn value, a withdrawal 1 to 30 days before today adds a quarter (0.25 times) of that value, and an older withdrawal adds none.

**Q. Which withdrawal and which value?** The program's most recent consignment withdrawal, whose item is the converted item, and the value booked on that withdrawal line.

**Q. How are days counted?** Calendar days from the withdrawal date to today: a withdrawal dated today is 0 days old.

**Q. Hypothetically, a withdrawal valued at 800.00 dated today?** A release of 400.00.

**Q. The same withdrawal dated 30 days before today?** 200.00. Dated 31 days before today, nothing.

| Days from the withdrawal to today | Release |
|---|---|
| 0 (same day) | half the withdrawn value |
| 1 to 30 | a quarter of the withdrawn value |
| 31 or more | none |
